title: Name
description: JSON Schema for a name — a kebab-case identifier. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens; begins and ends with a letter or digit; no consecutive hyphens. The schema captures the lexical shape only. Whether the name parses correctly against the project's name-grammar (gerund-headed for transformers, bare-noun for structures) is the resolution-conformance predicate enforced by the checking-a-name-for-grammar transformer. The schema declares $dynamicAnchor 'name-shape' so other schemas referencing a name field can $dynamicRef '#name-shape' rather than restating the pattern.
